sloka: धनदस्य सुतः श्रीमान् वानरो गन्धमादनः ।विश्वकर्मा तु अजनयन् नलम् नाम महा कपिम् ॥१-१७-१२॥
transliteration: dhanadasya sutaḥ śrīmān vānaro gandhamādanaḥ ।viśvakarmā tu ajanayan nalam nāma mahā kapim ॥1-17-12॥

translations.english: Neela, the prosperous son of Agni the firegod who equalled him in glow surpassed other monkeys in energy, renown and prowess.
